whatTheyArgued: Press reporting (/Film, read): Eastwood tries to get scenes in the first take, saying the objective is to make everything sound like the first time it is said; he asks for more takes only for rhythm or timing; he keeps sets relaxed and fast. His economy is economy of production process, not a doctrine about the brevity of a finished work or an answer.
